info.about_description: Gamevening helps you pick a game for tonight by time, platform, and mood: a ticket, a catalog, search, and hand-written collections.
info.about_p1: Gamevening helps you pick one game for today. The evening ticket asks how much time you have, what you play on, and the mood. If your shelf already fits, the ticket takes that.
info.about_p2: The catalog is for looking wider than the ticket: it has filters and search by name. Collections are written by hand, and each game has a reason. Swipes use the platforms and likes you chose. That is genre ranking from your ratings, not a separate model.
info.about_p3: An account is optional. The catalog, the ticket, and swipes work without signing in. Registration is for saving the shelf. A guest's platforms and likes stay in the browser. Names, covers, genres, platforms, and community scores come from RAWG. Gamevening text describes how the service works and why a game is in a collection. It does not replace the original game description.
info.about_renamed: Until October 2026 the project was called PlayHub.
info.faq_description: Short answers about the collection, the picker, and RAWG data.
info.faq_a1: The catalog and swipes work without an account. A guest's platforms and likes stay in the browser. After Google sign-in they move into the collection and do not overwrite games you already saved.
info.faq_q2: Where does game data come from?
info.faq_a2: Names, covers, genres, platforms, and the community score come from RAWG. Pages that show this data link back to the source.
info.faq_a3: After a few swipes Gamevening shows games in similar genres on the platforms you chose. Cards you rejected in the same session do not come back.

landing.meta: One evening ticket, a catalog, and your shelf. Say how long you have and what you play on.
landing.title: Gamevening — what to play: games by genre, platform, and mood
landing.about_1: Gamevening helps you pick one game for today instead of scrolling a catalog. Start with a ticket: how much time you have, what you play on, and the mood. If your shelf already fits, the ticket takes that.
landing.about_2: The catalog is for looking wider than the ticket. Search finds a game by name. The collections below are written by hand: short lists with a reason for each game.
landing.about_3: The shelf is your games, not someone else's ranking. An account is only for saving it. Scores stay on a scale, and the game data comes from RAWG.

landing.departing: Looking for a game for tonight
landing.deck_check: There is no separate Steam Deck list: check compatibility.
landing.empty_why: There is no honest match for this mix. Change the platform or the mood.
landing.shelf_why: It is already on your shelf. Start tonight instead of looking for another one.
landing.before: Evening is still ahead. You can take the ticket early.
landing.late: It's past midnight. A short session, then sleep.
landing.left: {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min until midnight. Enough for one good game.
landing.rules: We don't show a score without a scale. We don't call genre ranking artificial intelligence. A shelf is a time budget, not a debt. Game data comes from RAWG. No account until you choose to save a shelf.
